prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for rear-end collision. Insured reports being stopped at a traffic signal when struck from behind. Claimant vehicle identified. Police report requested. No injuries reported by insured at time of call.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received and logged. All further contact to go through counsel. Claimant reports neck strain and stiffness, treating with primary care provider. Medical authorization form sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Liability review in progress. Rear vehicle driver appears to have failed to stop in time based on statements and photos. Property damage estimate received for both vehicles. Rental coverage confirmed for claimant vehicle pending repair.

Entry 4: Medical records received from claimant's provider. Diagnosis consistent with cervical strain. Follow-up physical therapy recommended. Bill review assigned. Counsel requested a demand package, which is being reviewed for completeness before evaluation.

Entry 5: Reserve reviewed and adjusted based on injury documentation and property damage. Demand package evaluation scheduled. Diary set for follow-up with counsel on outstanding records and treatment status. File remains open pending settlement discussions.
